_meta.source: TBIMS National Database public-use files (Form 1 and Form 2, release 2021-10-06), Traumatic Brain Injury Model Systems Program; used under the TBIMS NDSC data-use agreement by Kaustav Mehta. Analysis code: CoMorb_Updated.ipynb (2022) reimplemented in Python 3 / pandas / networkx 3.7.
_meta.processing: See assets/data/tbi/README.md (Networks section). Every network was rebuilt from the raw files. Stats use networkx: betweenness = normalised betweenness_centrality on the graph without isolated nodes; eigenvector = eigenvector_centrality (unweighted) on the graph without isolates; clustering = local clustering coefficient; avgClusteringDeg2 averages only nodes with degree >= 2 (Gephi convention; the thesis 0.42 is this value), avgClusteringAllNodes is networkx average_clustering; avgPathLength/diameter are over reachable pairs. Layout: Kamada-Kawai on the union of the four published networks, lightly relaxed per network (20%), shared across networks (x, y in [0, 1], y down).
_meta.suppression: Only aggregates. Node prevalence is null where the count of yes or no answers is < 11. No row-level data, identifiers or dates.
_meta.prevalenceDefinition: yes / (yes + no) at that follow-up among respondents, any onset
_meta.nodeInfo: Labels, short names and colour categories live in nodeInfo (keyed by node id); per-network nodes carry only metrics, cluster ids and layout.
